changes: Only the runner scheduling and telemetry change; reuse the immutable parent design and flags.

estimates.basis: Measured unchanged parent HLS counts; registered synth budget 2.5 GiB each, C simulation 1 GiB. Total trial reservation 6 GiB, below 13 GiB with a 2 GiB available-memory floor.

interpretation: Compare reports with the parent and observed peak RSS with the registered budget. Overlap must be measured; numerical, II and timeout checks remain unchanged.
name: ws0_memory_control_F28
purpose: Controlled WS-0 memory admission validation using unchanged F28 source/arithmetic. Run F32 and F33 synthesis concurrently with F34 C simulation. Measure individual process-tree RSS, overlapping task timestamps, MemAvailable and CPU. Do not enable general hardware concurrency until this trial passes. No architecture speedup is claimed.
